item.guid: 2026-10-20 20:22STATUS CHANGE: cal-apis.com (core Events Portal callback + T
item.description: STATUS CHANGE: cal-apis.com (core Events Portal callback + Twitta panel domain, Cluster A, Dominet HK) - registrar switched nameservers from Cloudflare bill/paige to NS1/NS2.NONVERIFIEDDOMAIN.COM at 17:37Z (19:37 CEST) per Verisign RDAP; domain no longer resolves and /login is unreachable. Looks like a registrar hold/suspension for unverified registrant data (verified by us via RDAP+DoH; reason not confirmed). Sibling lookalikes cal-api.com and invitehandler.com still on Cloudflare bill/paige - watch for migration.
